# TrackTrendy
> Privacy-first, cookie-free website analytics for European businesses. GDPR compliant by design, from €4/month.

## About
TrackTrendy is a GDPR-compliant alternative to Google Analytics 4. It gives you full website analytics - visitors, sources, pages, countries, goals and revenue - without cookies, consent banners, or sending visitor data to third parties. It is designed to be readable without training, and includes revenue tracking, Google Search Console integration, team roles, a UTM campaign builder, and an AI assistant (coming soon).

## Pricing
- Single Site: 30 days free, then €4/month (or €40/year)
- 15 Sites: €15/month (or €150/year)

- [How to Manage Your Own Website Analytics Without an Agency](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/analytics-without-an-agency/): Most small businesses never hire a digital marketing agency, which means reading analytics usually falls to the owner.
- [New vs. Returning Visitors: What the Split Actually Tells You](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/new-vs-returning-visitors/): Returning visitors are usually a minority of sessions but disproportionately valuable.
- [Browser Fingerprinting: The Tracking Method That Skips the Cookie Banner](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/browser-fingerprinting-explained/): Fingerprinting identifies a visitor from signals their browser already exposes, no cookie required.
- [Traffic Sources Explained: Where Your Website Visitors Actually Come From](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/traffic-sources-explained/): Organic, direct, referral, social: every analytics tool sorts your visitors into sources.
- [Bot Traffic: Why Your Analytics Shows Visitors Who Are Not Human](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/bot-traffic-in-analytics/): Automated traffic now makes up more than half of all activity on the web.
- [Traffic From ChatGPT and AI Assistants: How to See It in Your Analytics](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/ai-assistant-referral-traffic/): AI assistants are starting to send real, measurable traffic, and it shows up as a referrer like any other.
- [Bounce Rate vs. Engagement Rate: Which One Should a Small Business Watch?](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/bounce-rate-vs-engagement-rate/): Bounce rate and engagement rate describe the same sessions from opposite directions.
- [Is Tracking Possible Without Cookies? How Cookieless Analytics Counts Visitors](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/cookieless-tracking-explained/): No cookie, no stored identifier, no consent banner -- so how does a cookieless tool still count a returning visitor?
- [Leaving Google Analytics: A Step-by-Step Checklist](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/leaving-google-analytics-checklist/): Switching analytics tools without losing data takes a sequence, not a single click.
- [What Is a Unique Visitor? A Plain Definition](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/what-is-a-unique-visitor/): A unique visitor is one real person counted once, no matter how many pages they load.
- [GDPR-Compliant Analytics: A Practical Checklist](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/gdpr-compliant-analytics-checklist/): A working checklist for getting your website measurement GDPR-compliant -- what to audit, what each tool type requires, and the shortcut that removes most of the list.
- [The End of Third-Party Cookies: What It Means for Your Website](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/end-of-third-party-cookies/): Safari and Firefox block them, Chrome kept them after years of U-turns, and regulators squeezed them anyway.
- [How Analytics Scripts Slow Your Site (and What It Costs You)](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/analytics-page-speed-core-web-vitals/): Your analytics stack is part of your page weight.
- [UTM Parameters: The Complete Guide to Campaign Tracking](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/utm-parameters-complete-guide/): UTM parameters tell you which campaigns actually bring visitors and customers.
- [The Website Metrics That Actually Matter for a Small Business](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/website-metrics-that-matter/): Most dashboards drown you in numbers that change nothing.
- [How to Track Conversions Without Cookies](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/track-conversions-without-cookies/): You do not need cookies to know whether your website converts.
- [Google Consent Mode v2 Explained (Without the Jargon)](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/google-consent-mode-v2-explained/): Google made Consent Mode v2 mandatory for ad features in Europe.
- [Ad Blockers and Analytics: Why Your Google Analytics Numbers Are Wrong](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/ad-blockers-and-analytics/): A meaningful share of your visitors block Google Analytics before it loads -- on top of the ones who decline your cookie banner.
- [Is Google Analytics Illegal in Europe?](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/is-google-analytics-illegal-in-europe/): Austria, France and Italy all ruled Google Analytics unlawful in 2022.
- [The Best Google Analytics Alternatives in 2026](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/google-analytics-alternatives/): GA4 is not the only way to understand your traffic.
- [How to Track Website Visitors Without a Cookie Banner](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/analytics-without-cookie-banner/): Cookie-free analytics tools let you capture 100% of your visitors without consent popups.
- [What Does Google Know About Me?](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/what-does-google-know-about-me/): Google collects your searches, location, browsing history, emails, and more — building a profile far more detailed than most people realise.
- [What Is Privacy-First Analytics?](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/privacy-first-analytics/): Privacy-first analytics collects website data without cookies, without storing personal information, and without requiring a GDPR consent banner.
- [Google Analytics Pricing: Is GA4 Really Free?](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/google-analytics-pricing/): GA4 is free — but Google charges you with your visitors' data.
- [Unique Visitors in Google Analytics: The Complete Guide](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/unique-visitors-google-analytics/): GA4 changed how unique visitors are counted compared to Universal Analytics.

- [How to Delete Your Google Analytics Account (Step by Step)](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/how-to-delete-google-analytics/): Ready to leave Google Analytics? Here's how to delete your GA4 account, what happens to your historical data, and how to export it before it's gone.
- [What Do Website Analytics Allow You to Do?](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/what-do-website-analytics-do/): Website analytics tell you who visits, where they come from, what they do, and where they leave.
- [CCPA and Web Analytics: What You Need to Know](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/ccpa-and-web-analytics/): The California Consumer Privacy Act affects any website with California visitors.
- [California Delete Act: What It Means for Your Data](https://tracktrendy.com/blog/california-delete-act/): California's Delete Act (SB 362) lets residents wipe their data from every data broker at once through a single state-run portal.
